integrity: The all-parameter theorem is analytic. Exact-rational computation is supplementary and is not used as a substitute for the proof. Literature comparisons distinguish the generic absolute-monotonicity radius from the graph-specific exact threshold.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple connected undirected graphs with symmetric Laplacian generators; the closed-form threshold is proved only for complete bipartite graphs with unit edge rates. Directed or weighted nonsymmetric generators and higher rational approximants are outside scope.
title: Exact Crank–Nicolson positivity threshold on complete bipartite Markov graphs
